record.paper_title: Open problems in local discrete holomorphic dynamics
record.original_question: For a holomorphic local dynamical system f with stable set K_f, what is the dynamical structure of the induced global system (K_f, f)? More specifically, how do orbits in K_f behave asymptotically near the fixed point, can they converge or exhibit chaotic behavior, can there be dense orbits, and what proper forward-invariant subsets of K_f can occur together with their internal dynamics?

evidence.quote: (Q2) What is the dynamical structure of (Kf , f)? For instance, what is the asymptotic behavior of the orbits? Do they converge to p, or have they a chaotic behavior? Is there a dense orbit? Do there exist proper f-invariant subsets...?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a complex manifold of dimension $m \ge 1$, let $p \in M$, and let $f \colon U \to M$ be a holomorphic map defined on an open neighborhood $U$ of $p$ with $f(p) = p$ (a holomorphic local dynamical system at $p$). For $n \ge 1$ let $f^n$ denote the $n$-th iterate of $f$, defined on the (possibly smaller) set where the previous iterates remain in $U$. The stable set of $f$ is
$$K_f \;=\; \{ z \in U : f^n(z) \in U \text{ for every } n \ge 0 \}.$$
Then $f$ restricts to a self-map $f \colon K_f \to K_f$, giving a global dynamical system $(K_f, f)$.

Describe the dynamical structure of $(K_f, f)$. In particular, address the following questions:

1. What is the asymptotic behavior, as $n \to \infty$, of the forward orbit $\{f^n(z)\}_{n \ge 0}$ for $z \in K_f$? Under what conditions on $f$ (e.g., on the spectrum of $df_p$, on resonances, or on the Jordan structure of $df_p$) must every orbit in $K_f$ converge to $p$?

2. Can $(K_f, f)$ exhibit chaotic behavior (for instance, sensitive dependence on initial conditions, positive topological entropy, or a hyperbolic invariant subset)?

3. Can $(K_f, f)$ admit a dense forward orbit in $K_f$?

4. Which proper, forward $f$-invariant subsets $S \subsetneq K_f$ (with $f(S) \subseteq S$) can occur, and what are the possible internal dynamics of $f|_S$?

Provide a classification, or as complete a description as possible, of the answers to (1)–(4) for holomorphic local dynamical systems at a fixed point.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as one of a list of open problems in local discrete holomorphic dynamics. No comprehensive classification of the dynamics on the stable set is known; partial results exist in special regimes (hyperbolic, parabolic, one-resonant, etc.) through work of Abate, Bracci, Hakim, Rivi, and others, but the general problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Discrete Holomorphic Local Dynamical Systems (Abate)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on local dynamics of holomorphic maps in one and several complex variables, discussing normal forms and the structure of local stable sets in the non-hyperbolic case.
status_evidence.claim: The structure of the stable set K_f and the dynamics on it is only partially understood, mostly in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Small divisors in discrete local holomorphic dynamics
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2023) survey on small divisor problems in local holomorphic dynamics, listing problems still under active investigation.
status_evidence.claim: Many problems regarding orbits and invariant sets near a fixed point of a holomorphic germ remain open.
